Stephen Kumar

Product Manager | AI Product Owner | B2B SaaS | Fintech | Healthcare Technology

stephencross365@gmail.com | +91 9740439122 | Bangalore

linkedin.com/in/stephen-kumar-ignatius-b2a5501a1

SUMMARY

Product Manager and AI Product Owner with 4 years of product experience and 9 years in the industry, delivering AI-powered, data-driven products across fintech, healthcare technology, banking, and enterprise B2B SaaS. Hands-on track record of owning product vision, roadmap, and backlog end-to- end, shipping Generative AI and Agentic AI products on Azure from 0 to 1, and driving measurable business impact through customer discovery, data analysis, and cross-functional delivery. Experienced across the full product lifecycle including market research, requirements gathering, user story authoring, sprint execution, go-to-market, UAT, and post-launch performance optimisation. Strong stakeholder management skills with a proven ability to align business, engineering, design, compliance, and operations teams around a shared product vision in fast-paced Agile and SAFe environments.

ACCOMPLISHMENTS

Won Best Business Value at the Global Vista AI Hackathon 2024, building and presenting an AI-

powered claims automation solution competing against 30+ teams across the organisation.

Won Best Overall at the Alegeus Internal Hackathon, identifying a $3.4M revenue opportunity

through customer fund utilisation data analysis and proposing an AI-powered personalisation

engine, beating 32 teams. Solution validated by senior leadership and added to the product

roadmap.

KEY PRODUCT IMPACT

Delivered three AI/LLM products end-to-end: GenAI-powered identity verification system, Agentic AI

claims decisioning platform, and Azure OpenAI-powered enterprise AI assistant

$1.1M+ annual cost savings through AI-powered product automation

40% reduction in processing turnaround time via LLM-based decisioning

$3.4M revenue opportunity identified through behavioural data analysis, validated by leadership and scaled into product roadmap

10-20% reduction in support ticket volume following overhaul of a platform serving 1.5M+ monthly active users

Sprint goals met 90% of sprints through disciplined backlog management and INVEST and Gherkin- compliant story authoring

Achieved HIPAA and WCAG 2.2 AA compliance across a large-scale regulated enterprise platform

AUM growth delivered through dividend reinvestment feature in collaboration with engineering and

external vendors

WORK EXPERIENCE

Product Manager / Product Owner | Alegeus Technologies

2024 – Present

Define and drive product vision, strategy, and roadmap for an AI-powered healthcare benefits and fintech SaaS platform, owning the full product lifecycle from discovery and business case development through go-to-market, UAT, and post-launch performance optimisation.

Led 0 to 1 delivery of a GenAI-powered HSA identity verification system built on Azure OCR and Azure OpenAI Service, navigating HIPAA compliance requirements and partnering with security, legal, and engineering teams throughout. Eliminated manual onboarding steps and accelerated customer contribution inflows.

Delivered an Agentic AI-powered claims decisioning platform leveraging LLMs for automated transaction processing and adjudication, reducing turnaround time by 40% and saving $1.1M+ annually. Owned full lifecycle from PRD through post-launch KPI tracking.

Owned PRD and end-to-end delivery of an Azure OpenAI-powered enterprise AI assistant, selected over alternatives based on data privacy, InfoSec, and governance requirements. Shipped to production with full adoption tracking post-launch.

Conduct product discovery across 300+ client configurations using SQL and Pendo product analytics, synthesising customer behaviour, usage patterns, and pain points to inform roadmap prioritisation and identify market opportunities.

Lead regular customer engagement sessions, product focus groups, and user research workshops on a recurring cadence, translating findings into product strategy and feature definitions that address real market needs.

Develop internal and external product documentation, release notes, and go-to-market collateral as

a core part of daily operations, enabling customers, sales, and support teams at every release.

Led full-scale UI/UX overhaul of a consumer-facing platform serving 1.5M+ monthly active users,

partnering with UX design and engineering throughout and driving a 10-20% reduction in support

ticket volume post-launch.

Author INVEST-compliant and Gherkin-format user stories, acceptance criteria, and epics across all

product initiatives, ensuring stories are execution-ready before sprint commitment. Sprint goals met 90% of sprints.

Own product backlog, Sprint Planning, Reviews, and Refinement in a SAFe Agile environment,

managing cross-functional dependencies and surfacing risks and trade-offs to leadership

proactively.

Support UAT cycles across all product releases, validating that delivered solutions meet defined

acceptance criteria and business expectations before go-live.

Manage stakeholder expectations across business, engineering, UX, compliance, legal, customer success, and operations teams, driving consensus and communicating product decisions clearly to senior leadership.

Senior Business Analyst / Product Owner | ATG Technologies

2021 – 2024

Owned product roadmap and backlog for the investments module of a large-scale financial services and healthcare SaaS platform, acting as Product Owner across Self-Directed, Managed, Open Brokerage, and In-Process investment account types for a multi-TPA client base.

Translated complex business and compliance requirements into epics, features, user stories, and

acceptance criteria, collaborating with engineering, design, and external vendors to ship product

changes end-to-end.

Defined API integration scope for the Drive Wealth vendor, specifying data flows, system

boundaries, and end-to-end user experience requirements across multiple account types.

Analysed usage patterns and abandonment rates to identify friction in complex financial workflows, driving data-informed UI simplification decisions that improved customer experience without backend changes.

Led customer engagement sessions and stakeholder workshops, gathering requirements and managing expectations across business, operations, compliance, and technology teams.

Drove WCAG 2.2 AA compliance and HIPAA standards across the regulated platform, identifying gaps and leading resolution in partnership with engineering and compliance teams.

Owned end-to-end release management, UAT coordination, and go-to-market preparation, communicating rollout plans and feature details to leadership, customer success, and support teams.

Developed internal and external product documentation and collateral for all feature releases, ensuring thorough communication of enhancements across client and internal teams.

Delivered dividend reinvestment feature in collaboration with engineering and external vendors, enabling users to reinvest funds and contributing to measurable AUM growth.

Senior Analyst | ANZ Bank

09/2019 – 08/2021

Partnered with risk, operations, and technology teams to streamline account opening and servicing workflows for ANZ's Australian and New Zealand retail banking operations, improving onboarding

turnaround time by 25%.

Managed high-value bank guarantees and financial instruments with strict accuracy and compliance

standards across hundreds of millions of dollars.

Customer Success Analyst | Accenture / Firstsource

02/2017 – 09/2019

Delivered frontline resolution in financial services, consistently ranked in top 5% for CSAT and first

call resolution, building customer empathy that directly informs product discovery and customer

engagement decisions.

SKILLS

Product Management | Product Owner | AI Product Owner | Product Vision and Strategy | Product

Roadmapping | Backlog Management and Prioritisation | Requirements Gathering and Documentation |

Epic, Feature and User Story Authoring | Acceptance Criteria (INVEST and Gherkin) | Product

Discovery and Customer Research | Customer Engagement and Focus Groups | Go-to-Market

Execution | Product Documentation and Collateral | UAT and Release Management | KPI Definition and Tracking | Stakeholder Management | Cross-Functional Collaboration | Generative AI | Agentic AI | LLM-Powered Products | Azure OpenAI | Azure DevOps | Kubernetes | GitHub Copilot | ServiceNow | AI Governance and Responsible AI | Data Analysis (SQL, Python) | Pendo (Product Analytics) | Figma | Agile (Scrum, SAFe / Scaled Agile Framework) | Sprint Planning, Reviews and Refinement | B2B SaaS | Fintech | Healthcare Technology | Banking and Financial Services | HIPAA Compliance | WCAG 2.2 AA | Vendor Management | API Integration | Market Research and Competitive Analysis | Continuous Improvement | Enterprise SaaS | Multi-Tenant Platform Products | Consumer-Facing Products | 0 to 1 Product Development | POC Structuring and Validation

CERTIFICATIONS

Professional Scrum Product Owner I (PSPO I) | Scrum.org | 06/2025

EDUCATION

Bachelor of Commerce (Operations Research) | CGPA 7.2 Indira Gandhi National Open University | 2019 – 2022
